findings.title: developer_mode enabled in production DB
findings.description: developer_mode=true allows disabling security monitoring with authorization code — should be false in production.
findings.remediation: Set developer_mode=false in system_configs (Settings or direct DB update).

findings.title: Vulnerable dependency: esbuild
findings.description: esbuild: Missing binary integrity verification in Deno module enables remote code execution via NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY (affected: 0.17.0 - 0.28.0)
findings.remediation: Run npm audit fix or update the package manually. Test after upgrading.

findings.title: Possible hardcoded secrets in source
findings.description: Found 4 file(s) matching sensitive string patterns (review manually).
findings.remediation: Move secrets to .env or system_configs; never commit real credentials in source.

findings.title: .gitignore missing entry: data/security-audit-reports
findings.description: Sensitive or local-only path "data/security-audit-reports" is not listed in .gitignore.

findings.title: World-readable sensitive file: .env
findings.description: .env has other-user read permission on this host.
findings.remediation: Restrict file permissions (e.g. chmod 600 on Unix; ACL on Windows).

findings.title: README documents dev JWT default
findings.description: README.md shows JWT_SECRET=supersecretkey as example — ensure production .env differs.
findings.remediation: Verify production .env uses a unique secret (audit secrets check covers this).
